acceptedThrough: round 27: typed numeric behavior, approximate-zero interactions and percentage-left addition; remaining special operations pending round 28

workingPrecision.rounding: nearest; exact ties away from zero
workingPrecision.stage: computed fractional result of each operation; subsequent operations use that working value
workingPrecision.exactRepresentableDecimalOperations: preserve the exact value when it fits the working precision
workingPrecision.guardDigits: permitted internally for numerical algorithms without changing the working result contract

integerMagnitude.overflow: diagnostic; no wrapping, truncation or saturation

display.rounding: nearest; exact ties away from zero

smallNonzero.trigger: rounding the shown numeric coefficient to 10 fractional places would give zero
smallNonzero.roundingStage: round the working coefficient directly to the required display places within the cap; do not round it to three significant digits and then round it again
smallNonzero.whenEvenMaximumPlacesRoundToZero: show approximately zero instead of a too-small diagnostic
smallNonzero.approximatelyZeroWorkingValue: retain the original nonzero working value for downstream calculations
smallNonzero.copy: 0; omit approximation sign, units and percent sign
smallNonzero.confirmation: ordinary quick confirmation; save true working value and shown approximation; clear/start new input only after success
smallNonzero.suffix: retain the ordinary unit or percentage suffix in display
smallNonzero.groupIdenticalApproximateEntries: existing display grouping with all latent typed values retained

percentages.ratePlusOrMinusRate: add or subtract rates; preserve percentage kind
percentages.multiplyOrDivideWithNumbersOrRates: special rule when both operands are ordinary numbers or percentages: calculate with numeric fractions and return an ordinary number without percentage kind
percentages.directStoredRate: preserve percentage kind when storing or passing by name
percentages.copy: divide displayed coefficient exactly by 100; no hidden digits or another rounding
percentages.leftHandRatePlusOrMinusOrdinaryNumber: operate on the numerical fraction and return an ordinary number; 10% + 200 = 200.1; 10% - 200 = -199.9
percentages.overridePriority: an applicable percentage-specific operation takes precedence over the other operand type handler; retain original left/right operand order

typedNumericBehavior.base: numeric types inherit common operations on a reference number
typedNumericBehavior.defaultResult: same type with transformed reference number and retained presentation context
typedNumericBehavior.typeSpecificRules: can constrain applicability or override combined operation and result type
typedNumericBehavior.explicitEarlierOverrides: remain applicable; in particular ordinary-number/percentage multiplication and division from round 26
